# Attach Files… and Attach from Photos… (insert_file, insert_photo): what's
# picked is typed into the pane as a drop types it, one quoted word each
# and a space. The pickers can't be driven, so the probe picks for them
# (insert-files:, insert-photos:) and the rest runs as the menu runs it. A
# read-only pane takes none. What Photos gives is kept as a file where
# pasted images are, in its own format (a HEIC stays HEIC), and that
# file's path typed. @DIR@: this test's folder; @ROOT@: the repository.
size:1280x800
shell:mkdir -p "@DIR@" && : > "@DIR@/a b.txt" && : > "@DIR@/it's.txt"
shell:cp "@ROOT@/assets/icon/png/libertty-32.png" "@DIR@/Screen Shot.png" && sips -s format heic "@ROOT@/assets/icon/png/libertty-32.png" --out "@DIR@/IMG_0001.heic" > /dev/null
wait:1.5
type:printf '<%s>\n'
key:space
insert-files:@DIR@/a b.txt|@DIR@/it's.txt
key:enter
wait:0.8
expect:<@DIR@/a b.txt>
expect:<@DIR@/it's.txt>
# Read-only: nothing typed, and the action says it didn't run.
action:toggle_readonly
insert-files-refused:@DIR@/refused.txt
insert-photos-refused:@DIR@/IMG_0001.heic
action:toggle_readonly
type:echo READ-ONLY-DONE
key:enter
wait:0.8
expect:READ-ONLY-DONE
expect-not:refused.txt
expect-not:IMG_0001.heic
# From Photos: copies, named after the photo, in the order picked.
type:printf '[%s]\n'
key:space
insert-photos:@DIR@/IMG_0001.heic|@DIR@/Screen Shot.png
key:enter
wait:0.8
expect:-IMG_0001.heic]
expect:-Screen-Shot.png]
expect:libertty-paste/photo-
expect-shell:ls "$LIBERTTY_DATA_DIR/libertty-paste" ==> -IMG_0001.heic
expect-shell:sips -g format "$LIBERTTY_DATA_DIR"/libertty-paste/photo-*-IMG_0001.heic ==> format: heic
expect-shell:ls "@DIR@" ==> IMG_0001.heic
# What can't be had from Photos says so on the window, and nothing's typed.
type:echo NOTHING-TYPED:
insert-photos:@DIR@/a b.txt
expect-sheet:yes
expect-sheet-text:neither a picture nor a video
sheet:OK
expect-sheet:no
key:enter
wait:0.8
expect:NOTHING-TYPED:
expect-not:NOTHING-TYPED:/
expect-not:NOTHING-TYPED:'
# On a host's pane (the stand-in ssh's, LIBERTTY_SSH): sent there first,
# and where it is there typed. (The window takes the host's name; its new
# split runs there.)
shell:printf 'sent-to-the-host\n' > "@DIR@/up load.txt"
pretend-host:liberttytest
action:new_split:right
wait:6
type:echo HOST-UP-$((40+2))
key:enter
wait:1.0
expect:HOST-UP-42
type:cat
key:space
insert-files:@DIR@/up load.txt
wait:1.5
expect:/uploads/
key:enter
wait:0.8
expect:sent-to-the-host
